sources.title: Fictional arithmetic fixture; not observations about a real issuer

cash.basis: Fictional nonoperating cash in USD millions.

debt.basis: Fictional debt claims, consistently treated with operating forecasts.

other_claims.basis: Explicit zero for the fixture; no omitted real-company claims.

shares_outstanding.basis: Fictional current basic shares in millions; not weighted-average EPS shares.

valuation_shares.basis: Fictional current basic shares plus 5 million incremental diluted shares; assumes no separate option-value deduction.

market_price.basis: Fictional per-share price in USD; not a market quote.

market_cap.basis: Fictional price × current basic shares, in USD millions.

assumptions.rationale: All inputs are invented solely to exercise the arithmetic. No discount rate, growth or margin here is an estimate about a real company. Terminal reinvestment is g/ROIC.

forecasts.rationale: Fictional full-year forecast. Net reinvestment includes every operating investment after applicable noncash charges and working-capital changes exactly once.
Fictional full-year forecast using an explicit all-inclusive net-reinvestment amount.
Fictional 366-day full-year forecast; terminal assumptions begin after this period.
